faqs.q: How quickly can you fix a leak?
faqs.a: For urgent leaks we prioritize emergency response across the Central Pacific. Write to us on WhatsApp and we will reply within 48 hours to schedule a technician or dispatch right away depending on severity.

faqs.q: Do you install hydro-pneumatic pumps and water heaters?
faqs.a: Yes. We design and install hydro-pneumatic pressure systems and water heaters for homes and businesses, sized to your water demand and coordinated with certified electrical work when needed.

faqs.q: Is plumbing work covered by a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes, all our work is guaranteed: from 3 months for repairs up to 24 months for major installations. We use certified materials and test every system before handover.
